description: This Scala source file defines the class SQLOpenHashSet, a wrapper around OpenHashSet that handles nulls and NaN values according to SQL semantics, including methods for adding, checking, and generating code for null and NaN handling.

classes.name: SQLOpenHashSet
classes.description: A specialized hash set for SQL that can handle nulls and NaN values, supporting add and containment checks.

methods.name: addNull
methods.description: Marks the set as containing null.

methods.name: addNaN
methods.description: Marks the set as containing NaN.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the hash set.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an element is in the hash set.

methods.name: containsNull
methods.description: Checks if null has been added to the set.

methods.name: containsNaN
methods.description: Checks if NaN has been added to the set.
